versions.changelog:
Cleaning Service & Maid Service Marketing Kit v1.0.0

- Initial release offering 4 specialized marketing content prompts for cleaning and maid service businesses.
- Built-in compliance checks: OSHA HazCom, EPA Safer Choice, FTC Green Guides, FTC Endorsement Guides, TCPA/CAN-SPAM, insurance/bonding, IRS worker classification, and state/local licensing.
- Free tier: Seasonal campaign and brand positioning generator with ad, SMS, and review templates.
- Paid: Detailed service page generator (with schema), reputation/review system, and digital ad/local SEO/Airbnb outreach toolkit.
- All templates and outputs are character-count enforced and regulatory-aware, tailored for residential, commercial, and short-term rental cleaning markets.
